behavior.scale: The wheel delta applies an exponential multiplier to the current zoom level.
behavior.anchor: The rendered graph point beneath the mouse cursor remains fixed while zooming.
behavior.nativeWheelHandler: disabled to prevent double zoom; drag panning and programmatic Fit remain enabled

regressionCoverage: multiplicative scaling from the current level
equivalent normalized page and pixel deltas

activation: Reload the Foundry client with Ctrl+F5; no server restart is required.
